description: stoa-imap has zero observability instrumentation — no metrics, no traces, no Prometheus endpoint, nothing. Needs: Prometheus metrics (connection counts, command durations, auth failures at minimum), /metrics endpoint, and full OTel SDK integration matching transit/reader pattern. Files: crates/imap/Cargo.toml, new crates/imap/src/metrics.rs, new crates/imap/src/telemetry.rs, crates/imap/src/main.rs.
title: Add observability to stoa-imap (metrics + OTel)
